newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares hit new high, upside seen.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares hit new high, upside seen.

text.p: 1735 GMT - The PSI20 index of leading shares hit a record high in good volume with traders seeing more upside. Non-residents were back in the market, with the index seen capable of further gains before the year's end.
*"The market is going to continue positive, supported by the return of the foreign investor and the feeling that there is still some upside before the year ends," said one trader.
*The .PSI20 closed 0.58 percent higher at 5,005.39, in total turnover of nearly nine billion escudos. The December futures also edging 17 points higher to 5,015.
*Traders said the volumes, particularly on Sonae and Cimpor, were probably linked to the launch on Wednesday of an investment fund by Banco Santander de Negocios (Portugal).
*Sonae Investimentos was the day's most-heavily traded share, while Cimpor gained in lively business of 321,778 shares.
*The rights to the Jeronimo Martins capital call were up 39 escudos at 145.
